challenges.title: Rebuild the pricing page conversion flow
challenges.summary: Find where the pricing page loses people, then rebuild the flow around it.
challenges.body: Our pricing page converts at roughly half the rate of the rest of the funnel. We have session recordings, event data and a year of A/B history. Work out where people stall and rebuild the flow around that.

challenges.title: Ship a data pipeline for churn signals
challenges.summary: Turn raw events into churn signals we would actually act on.
challenges.body: Events land in Postgres but nothing turns them into churn signals. Build the pipeline and define the signals you would actually trust.

challenges.title: Model retention cohorts from raw events
challenges.summary: Cut retention by cohort and tell us which split matters.
challenges.body: We have never cut retention by cohort. Build the model, then tell us which cohort split actually changes a decision.

challenges.title: Redesign the onboarding checklist
challenges.summary: Our onboarding checklist is ignored. Fix it, or make the case to cut it.
challenges.body: New users hit a six-item checklist and finish an average of 1.4 items. Redesign it, or argue for removing it entirely.
